usage: deskops advance [-h] {task} ...

positional arguments:
  {task}
    task      Advance one actionable task through the desk's lifecycle graph.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

Example:
  deskops advance task task-fix-thing --root .

Advancement fires the first lifecycle transition (an sldb RelationDoc between rituals) whose condition holds for the task.
Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
